grammar.ds: Descriptive noun modifier; some short combinations omit 的.
Yuan (元/块) or hundredths of a yuan (分).
Half of a counted item or amount.

ex.translation: I drink half a cup of milk.

grammar.ds: Prohibition: do not do something.
Contextually related clauses without an explicit connector.

ex.translation: I finish work, and you go to work.

grammar.ds: Further fact/action; additive 还, not still.

ex.translation: I drink tea, and I also drink milk.

grammar.ds: Parallel additional fact; repeated subject may be omitted.

ex.translation: I love Dad, and I love Mom too.

grammar.ds: Ordinal number; retain a measure word before a counted noun.

ex.translation: I am reading the second book.

grammar.ds: Hundreds before the remainder; keep initial 一, omit trailing zeros.

ex.translation: This item of clothing costs one hundred yuan.

grammar.ds: Read year or identifier digits individually.
Thousands before the remainder; keep initial 一.

ex.translation: The computer costs one thousand yuan.

grammar.ds: Location suffix; established compounds may use neutral tone.

ex.translation: The cat is behind the table.

grammar.ds: Context-supported utterance without a full subject-predicate structure.
Very; high degree.
All/both of the preceding group.

grammar.pt: <higher place value> + 零 + <lower nonzero place value>
grammar.pr: <higher place value> + líng + <lower nonzero place value>
grammar.ds: Bridge skipped internal places with one 零; no trailing zero.

ex.translation: The mobile phone costs one thousand and eight yuan.

grammar.ds: Half past the stated hour.

ex.translation: I get up at half past eight.

grammar.ds: 几 asks a usually small count with a measure word; 多少 an open quantity.

ex.translation: How many books do you have?

grammar.ds: Two before most measure words; 二 for digits, ordinals and tens.
Identify what occupies a location; distinct from existential 有.
There is/are at a place; indefinite noun, quantity optional.

ex.translation: There is a cup on the table.

grammar.ds: A noun specifying the following noun's type or topic.

grammar.pt: <noun> + (上 / 下 / 里 / 外 / 前 / 后)
grammar.ds: Location relative to the preceding noun.

ex.translation: The dog is under the table.

grammar.ds: Which one, with the noun's measure word.
Which ones; no extra individual measure word.
Join noun phrases, not full clauses.
What about this person or thing? Contextual follow-up.

ex.translation: I am a student. What about you?

grammar.ds: Where is this person or thing? Search context.

ex.translation: I am looking for my mobile phone. Where is it?

grammar.ds: Cupful measure 杯, distinct from the container noun 杯子.

ex.translation: I would like a cup of tea.

grammar.ds: Count with a noun-appropriate measure word; understood noun may drop.
Count years/days/minutes directly; other time units may differ.

ex.translation: I am staying here for three days.

grammar.ds: Possessive modifier; 的 may drop in close family relationships.
Age in years; no 是 required.

ex.translation: My younger brother is nine years old.

grammar.pt: <before answer> + (谁 / 什么 / 哪儿 / 哪里) + <after answer>？
grammar.pr: <before answer> + (shéi / shén me / nǎ r / nǎ lǐ) + <after answer>?
grammar.ds: Who/what/where in the answer slot; no extra 吗.

grammar.pt: <verb or adjective> + 不 + <same verb or adjective>？
grammar.pr: <verb or adjective> + bù + <same verb or adjective>?
grammar.ds: A-not-A question; repeat the predicate, without 吗.
A preposition and its object form a phrase.
Plural pronouns or human nouns; not ordinary numbered noun phrases.
Personal pronouns keep their form as subjects and objects.
Polite request.
Go/come somewhere to act; shared subject.

ex.translation: I am going to the bookstore to buy books.

grammar.ds: Adjective used adverbially before a verb; construction-dependent.
Negate habits, intentions or descriptions; not possession or completed events.
Attitude toward a person or thing.

ex.translation: My older sister is kind to me.

grammar.ds: The addressee of a compatible speech action.

ex.translation: I say to the teacher, "Thank you!"

grammar.ds: Ask degree or measurement: how old, big, tall, etc.

ex.translation: How old is your younger brother?

grammar.ds: Also/in addition, not still.

ex.translation: I have books. I also have a computer.

grammar.ds: The person an action is performed with.
Adjective description; unstressed 很 need not mean very.
Learned ability, not general ability or permission.

ex.translation: I know how to write Chinese characters.

grammar.ds: Nonoccurrence; 没 abbreviates 没有. Normally omit completed-action 了.
Lack of possession or existence; negative of 有.
能: ability/circumstances; 可以: permission/possibility.
Context-supported nominal predicate, e.g. age/date/price; not arbitrary 是 omission.
Basic subject-predicate statement.
Identify or classify with a noun.
Person before thing with a double-object verb, such as 给.

ex.translation: I am giving you an apple.

grammar.ds: Verbal statement; no auxiliary 是.
Contextual ongoing action marked by final 呢 alone.
Shared subject; first action supplies the means for the second.

ex.translation: I am taking a taxi to the hospital.

grammar.ds: Shared-subject actions in sequence or purpose relation.

ex.translation: I have come to meet you.

grammar.ds: Want or intend to act.
Want, need or intend to act; often stronger than 想.
Also/too; precedes the predicate.

ex.translation: You are a student. I am a student too.

grammar.ds: Ask whether something is possessed; negative part 没有, not 不有.
Possession; have something.
Be located at a place.
Action location before the verb; not progressive 在.
Ongoing activity; distinguish progressive 在 from location.
Ongoing activity emphasized by 呢; not static possession.

ex.translation: He is eating lunch right now.

grammar.ds: Time before the action; 今天/明天 normally omit 在.

ex.translation: I make a phone call after class.

grammar.ds: Again for a future or intended repetition.
How an action is performed.

ex.translation: How do you get to school?

grammar.ds: New or changed situation; sentence-final 了.
Suggestion or softened request, inviting agreement.
Yes/no question; statement order. Not with question words or A-not-A.
So/too; admiration or excess, not past tense.
10-99; omit initial 一 in 10-19 and a zero ones digit.
Hour then minutes; omit exact-hour minutes; time of day as needed.

ex.translation: I go to school at seven forty in the morning.

grammar.ds: Time before the action, before or after the subject.
How is it? Request a description or assessment.
Insert aspect or quantity inside a separable verb-object word; not all compounds separate.
Completed/bounded event, not past tense; object only when licensed.
Count brief actions; 一下 can soften a request.
A transitive verb precedes its object.
Telephone greeting.
Familiar surname prefix, often for someone younger.
一-六: Monday-Saturday; 日/天: Sunday.

grammar.pt: <year digits> + 年 + <month number> + 月 + <day number> + (日 / 号)
grammar.pr: <year digits> + nián + <month number> + yuè + <day number> + (rì / hào)
grammar.ds: Year-month-day; year as digits, month/day as cardinal numbers.
A small quantity of a mass noun.

ex.translation: I would like a little rice.

grammar.ds: Some members; 有的 permits an understood noun to be omitted.

grammar.pr: (yǒu diǎn r / yǒu yī diǎn r) + <adjective>
grammar.ds: Somewhat, often undesirably; before the adjective.
Spoken fractional yuan: 三块五 means 3.50 yuan, not 3.05.

ex.translation: This steamed bun costs three yuan fifty.

grammar.pt: (这里 / 这儿 / 那里 / 那儿) + <predicate>
grammar.pr: (zhè lǐ / zhè r / nà li / nà r) + <predicate>
grammar.ds: Here/there as a place expression.
This/that counted thing; retain its measure word.
Identify this or that person/thing.
These/those; omit an understood noun.
Really/truly; emphatic evaluation.

ex.translation: This steamed bun is really tasty!
